releases.notes:
# Safepaths v2.0.2 — Stability

**Minecraft:** 1.21.1 · **Loader:** NeoForge 21.1.235+ · **Java:** 21

### 🛡️ Fixed

* Fixed holes appearing when unused paths restored sand, red sand, gravel, or other falling terrain above air, liquids, or replaceable blocks, including roads directly over water. Paths now remain intact until support returns, then restore their original terrain automatically.
* Rejected air variants, liquids, non-solid blocks, and block entities as conversion targets. Unsupported falling targets and targets that cannot survive at the position no longer replace terrain; blocks with inventories or other block-entity data are protected from trampling.
* Invalidated stale decay records when roads are replaced, and cleared tracking for every block affected by piston chains and player placement.
* Preserved original block properties and creator permission context across world saves while retaining compatibility with older path-memory data.
* Enforced MineColonies break/place permissions for players and colony ownership for civilian path creators. Decay rechecks creator permissions before changing claimed ground.
* Corrected duplicate conversions so the first explicit rule wins and unused targets no longer grant road speed. Explicit conversions continue to override self-mapping rules.
* Applying a self-mapping rule to an existing tracked road now clears its old decay record without changing the road.
* Preserved unsaved speed and search inputs when the conversion editor reopens or resizes. Multiplayer clients now receive server configuration instructions instead of editing unrelated local settings.
* Prevented jumping or creative flight from counting as additional footsteps on the same ground block.

### Changed

* Indexed path records by chunk so decay maintenance skips individual unloaded positions without force-loading terrain. Active path timestamps are refreshed at most once per second, and disabled speed boosts skip footprint scanning.
* Build and publishing workflows now require the in-world GameTests to pass both with and without MineColonies before completing.
* Publishing now pins the release tag, loader, Minecraft version, Java version, and optional MineColonies dependency, and uploads the same tested JAR to GitHub, Modrinth, and CurseForge.

### Upgrade notes

* Existing configurations and older path-memory saves remain compatible. Back up your world before updating, then replace the mod JAR and restart.
* The road-safety fix prevents unsupported terrain restoration from creating new holes; it does not rebuild blocks that were already missing.

### Download & installation

Use `safepaths-2.0.2-1.21.1-neoforge.jar` for Minecraft **1.21.1** on **NeoForge 21.1.235+**. MineColonies is optional; use its matching Minecraft/loader edition if installed. Replace the old Safepaths JAR instead of keeping both versions.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ahm3tak1f616/Safepaths/compare/v2.0.1...v2.0.2)

releases.notes:
# 🚀 Safepaths v2.0.1 — Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge Edition)

We are thrilled to officially bring **Safepaths v2.0.1 to Minecraft 1.20.1 on Minecraft Forge**! This release brings full feature parity with our 1.21.1 NeoForge edition, featuring native Forge configuration, updated companion mod integration, and all the latest v2.0.1 mechanics and fixes.

---

### 🌟 New: Forge 1.20.1 Dedicated Features
* 🛠️ **Native 1.20.1 Forge Architecture** — Optimized for Forge 1.20.1 with Java 17 toolchains.
* 🖥️ **Dedicated In-Game Configuration Screen** — Added a native Forge options GUI accessible directly from the Mods list. Easily configure Required Footsteps, Path Construction Time Limits, Decay Timers, and Speed Multipliers in a clean, intuitive interface with full localization.
* 🏛️ **MineColonies & Mod Compatibility** — Synchronized with the latest 1.20.1 snapshots for *MineColonies*, *Structurize*, *Domum Ornamentum*, *BlockUI*, and *Multi-Piston*. Colony citizens, visitors, and mercenaries naturally compress roads across your settlement.
* 🌍 **1.20.1 Modded Biome Support** — Out-of-the-box pre-configured road conversions for *Biomes O' Plenty*, *Regions Unexplored*, and *Oh The Biomes We've Gone*.

---

### 🥾 Path Collision & Surface Tracking Fixes (v2.0.1 Parity)
* **Sub-Block Y-Offset Collision (`getOnPos`):** Fixed an issue where walking on non-full blocks (like `dirt_path` with its 15/16 height or sinking blocks like `mud`) checked the foundation block underneath instead of the path itself.
* **Decay Lifetime Refresh:** Walking over existing dirt paths now reliably refreshes their lifetime on every step, ensuring heavily trafficked roads never unexpectedly decay back to grass under your feet.
* **Sub-Surface Trampling Prevention:** Eliminated an issue where walking along established paths would unintentionally trample the dirt block *beneath* the road into an invisible second path layer.

### ⏳ Chunk Unload Decay Preservation
* **Persistent World Memory:** Paths in unloaded chunks are now preserved in dimension `SavedData` until reloaded, rather than being prematurely discarded.
* **Natural Wilderness Restoration:** Abandoned roads in remote outposts or unvisited dimensions will now properly decay and revert to their natural ground block once you return to the area, rather than freezing into permanent dirt paths forever.

### ⚡ Roadway Precedence & Safety Guards
* **Explicit Conversion Override:** If both a self-mapping rule (e.g. `gravel -> gravel`) and an explicit conversion rule (e.g. `gravel -> dirt_path`) are declared, the explicit transformation cleanly takes precedence.
* **Speed-Only Roadway Immunity:** Added an architectural guard ensuring self-mapped roadways (such as gravel, cobblestone, or stone bricks) are permanently immune to being converted into dirt paths through external mod interactions or edge-case calls.

### 🎨 In-Game GUI Polish & International Usability
* **International Decimal Input:** The master speed multiplier input now supports both period (`0.2`) and comma (`0,2`) decimal separators, eliminating silent input drops on international keyboard layouts (German, French, Turkish, Spanish, etc.).
* **Direct Input Synchronization:** Clicking directly into either the source or target text box in the Conversions Screen automatically syncs that slot with the Block Palette, making block selection faster and more intuitive.

### 🧪 Stability & Automated GameTests
* **NBT Serialization Null-Safety:** Added fallback null-safety during dimension data serialization to safeguard world saves against corrupted or missing target block entries.
* **Automated GameTest Suite:** Ported full in-engine automated GameTest suites (`safepaths:platform`) verifying path tags, farmland immunity, persistent memory, and self-mapped road recognition.

---

### 📦 Download & Installation
* **Minecraft Version:** `1.20.1`
* **Mod Loader:** `Forge 47.3.0+` (or compatible)
* **File:** `safepaths-x.x.x-1.20.1-forge.jar`

releases.notes:
# What's Changed in v2.0.0

### ⚡ Speed Roads & Self-Mapping
* **Speed-Only Road Blocks:** You can now map any block to itself (e.g. `stone_bricks -> stone_bricks` or `gravel -> gravel`) in the config or GUI! Walking over these blocks grants the full movement speed bonus without trampling, replacing, or tracking decay on the block.
* **Gravel Road Preservation:** By popular demand, gravel roads in the default config are now self-mapped (`minecraft:gravel -> minecraft:gravel`). Your carefully placed gravel roads will grant speed boosts and will no longer be turned into dirt paths.
* **Conflict & Duplicate Resolution:** Added deterministic conflict resolution (`putIfAbsent`). If duplicate or conflicting rules are declared, the first rule takes priority cleanly without toggling or breaking in-game.

### 🎨 In-Game Visual Editor & GUI
* **Visual Conversions Screen:** Configure your path conversions directly in-game! Includes an interactive block palette, real-time search filter, item icons, and animated selection borders.
* **Master Speed Controls:** Easily toggle the speed boost ON/OFF and adjust the global speed multiplier directly inside the conversion screen.
* **Config Screen Stability:** Added null-safe tooltip checks to the NeoForge mod configuration menu (`IConfigScreenFactory`), ensuring crash-free access from the in-game Mods menu.

### ⏳ Authentic Decay & Memory Persistence
* **Smart Decay Restoration:** Paths that decay now revert to their authentic original ground block (e.g. sand paths revert to sand, peat paths to peat) rather than always turning into plain dirt.
* **Dimension `SavedData` Persistence:** Trample progress and decay timers are now cleanly saved in dimension NBT data, persisting across server reboots and dimension transitions without memory leaks.
* **Unloaded Chunk Pruning:** Distant and unloaded path tracking entries are automatically pruned after a multi-day grace period, ensuring zero chunk-loading lag.

### 🌐 Biome Mod Compatibility
* **Vanilla-Block Worldgen Overhauls:** Verified 100% out-of-the-box compatibility with **Terralith** and **Geophilic** without requiring any extra setup.
* **Modded Surface Soil Defaults:** Pre-configured out-of-the-box conversions for popular biome mods:
  * *Oh The Biomes We've Gone (BWG)*
  * *Biomes O' Plenty (BOP)*
  * *Regions Unexplored*

### 🧪 Automated Testing & Code Quality
* **Automated GameTest Suite:** Verified with 7 passing in-engine GameTests covering pathing heuristics, farmland immunity, and persistent memory.
* **Refined Architecture:** Cleaned up code structure, eliminated redundant suppression warnings, and streamlined event execution.

---

### 📦 Download & Installation
* **Minecraft Version:** `1.21.1`
* **Mod Loader:** `NeoForge 21.1.235+`
* **File:** `safepaths-2.0.0.jar`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ahm3tak1f616/Safepaths/compare/v1.2.0...v2.0.0
